_comment: Fictional backlog items from the example project (Harbor Claims Assistant), one per rating outcome.

stories.summary: Offer the vendor's test requests by name on the Eligibility screen
stories.description: As a billing specialist I want to pick one of the vendor's published test requests by name so that I can try eligibility in test mode without typing an identity by hand.
acceptance_criteria: Given eligibility runs in the vendor's test mode, When I open the Eligibility screen, Then each published test request is listed by name
Given I choose a test request, When the form fills, Then nothing is sent until I submit
Given a production key is configured, When I open the screen, Then no test requests are offered

stories.description: Build the re-status job. Must use the existing batch table and add a column for the ceiling. Should be fast.
As a billing specialist I want to find a member's plans from their demographics so that claims for patients with an unknown payer can still be checked. Scope of accepted identifiers is TBD.

stories.summary: Refactor design-system tokens for dark mode
acceptance_criteria: Given dark mode is on, When any screen renders, Then text contrast is at least 4.5:1
